target_customer: Independent financial advisors (RIAs) who offer borrowing against investment portfolios to their clients
problem: Borrowing against a portfolio through bank lines or margin loans is expensive. SyntheticFi uses box spreads on listed options to offer cheaper securities backed loans through RIAs.
business_model: Fee on securities backed loans originated through advisors, SEC registered investment advisor

founders.name: Tony Yang
education: UC Berkeley, computer science and philosophy
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was a senior software engineer at Stripe and used a box spread to buy his house, which inspired the company.

founders.name: Joseph Yezhou Wang
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no background; notes he wrote a CBOE article on the product.

technical_complexity.rationale: Box spread execution across custodians, pricing and compliance as an SEC registered adviser is complex financial engineering, but built from standard exchange listed instruments.

defensibility.rationale: SEC registration, custodian integrations with Schwab, Pershing, Fidelity and Interactive Brokers, and advisor relationships take time to copy, but the box spread technique itself is public.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Custodians sell their own securities backed lines to RIAs, which SyntheticFi positions against. No record of an incumbent copying the box spread approach was found.

market_need_then: RIAs were already adopting securities backed lending, with Fidelity reporting RIA segment balances up 63 percent over two years per an InvestmentNews article. The cheapest borrowing claim targets high bank line rates.

branding.domain_note: Uses syntheticfi.com, an exact .com for the brand name.

identity.logo: Not described by any source seen
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct value claims: lowest interest, easiest entry, fully deductible

branding.brand_signature: Positioning line: Borrow smarter. Save More.
branding.community_and_virality: None found. A USPTO word mark application was filed with first use dated 2024-09-01.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive coinage that explains the product to finance insiders but is easy to confuse with Synthetix and other synthetic named firms; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: SyntheticFi sells cheaper portfolio backed loans through RIAs and grew to a stated 2 billion in regulatory assets and over 300 advisory firms by June 2026, when it announced a 13 million round. Its distribution through advisors and its founder's personal use of the box spread explain the traction. Active and growing with no exit.
notes: The June 2026 round is stored as stage other because the company post does not name the stage; Dealroom calls it a Series A and Seedtable gives no label. Earlier funding is unknown: VC Backed lists only 500K, not verified. No SEC Form D was found. Competitor list is empty because no 2023 dated source was opened (the InvestmentNews article on RIA securities backed lending is undated in the snippet). Press says the company was founded in 2023 by quantitative developers and finance specialists.
